prompt: People are hitting edge-case corruption in the base64 codec: url-safe text decodes to the wrong bytes, inputs that come in without padding come back garbled, and single trailing bytes vanish from encoded output altogether. Worse, a dangling single character that should be rejected outright is being silently decoded into a byte. The behaviour we agreed on is written down in docs/codec-spec.md — make the implementation match it. The tests under test/ are the reproductions we managed to write, not the whole acceptance criteria.
